title: Robot Car
subtitle: ESP32 based smart robotic car with L298N motor control
desc: Build a wireless robot car using ESP32, motor driver and DC motors!
fullDesc: A smart robotic car project using ESP32 microcontroller, L298N motor driver and four DC motors.
author: Atul Sawant

hardwareSpecs.motorDriver: L298N Dual Full H-Bridge (2A continuous per channel)
hardwareSpecs.motors: 4x TT DC Geared Motors (1:48 reduction ratio)
hardwareSpecs.radarSensor: HC-SR04 Ultrasonic Rangefinder mounted on SG90 Pan Servo
